title: Spec5 Beacon
description: Solar node in a PETG case with a ceramic GPS antenna.
commentary: We do not recommend the Spec5 Beacon. We've seen multiple units fall apart with only 3 months of exposure to sun and wind. There are multiple weak points including the solar panel screw, waterproofing seal, and antenna reliability.
